entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD

sentences.text: None present on behalf of opposite party no.2 even in the revised call.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned AGA for the State.

This Transfer Application has been moved by the applicant for transfer of Case No.65 of 2022 (Smt.
Nida Khanam vs. Muzahid Ashif Khan) under Section 125 CrPC, pending in the court of Principal Judge, Family Court, District Kasganj to the court of having competent jurisdiction in District Etah.

entities.text: Nida Khanam vs. Muzahid Ashif Khan
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Principal Judge, Family Court, District Kasganj
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Main submission is that applicant is wife of opposite party no.2 and living at her parental home and not in a position to attend the court.
It is also submitted that a case under Section 498A IPC is also pending in District Kasganj.
Distance between Etah and Kasganj is about 30 kms but residence of applicant is about 80 kms.
The grounds for transfer of the aforesaid case is insufficient and this criminal transfer application lacks merit and is liable to be rejected.
